site_title: TanStarter Lite | Smaller starter, faster website
site_description: The lite version of TanStarter: a minimal bilingual starter for simple websites, built with React, TanStack Start, dark mode, SEO, and Cloudflare Workers.
hero_badge: ONE LANDING PAGE · NO BACKEND OVERHEAD
hero_description: TanStarter Lite gives a simple website what it actually needs: bilingual content, dark mode, SEO, tests, and one-command Cloudflare deployment.
foundation_title: Between a blank repo and a full SaaS, there is a useful middle ground
foundation_description: Starting from a blank project still means setting up design, routing, localization, metadata, accessibility, tests, and deployment. A SaaS starter adds accounts and infrastructure. TanStarter Lite keeps the essentials and leaves the rest out.
foundation_quote: Start with the website you need, not the product you might build later.
stack_title: A familiar stack, trimmed to the essentials
stack_description: Development and production use the same modern tools. Every dependency earns its place in the visitor experience.
stack_react_detail: A current component model, without an app-state framework added by default.
stack_tanstack_detail: File-based routing and server rendering for a simple site that loads fast and can be indexed.
stack_i18n_detail: Type-safe English and Chinese messages with localized URLs.
stack_cloudflare_detail: Deploy globally with no database, bucket, KV namespace, or secret setup.
architecture_title: The structure stays clear as the site grows
architecture_description: Routes handle pages. Components handle presentation. Locale files hold the copy. Configuration holds site identity. No module registry obscures how things fit together.
architecture_routes_detail: The home page, its Chinese version, and SEO endpoints for machines.
architecture_components_detail: Focused building blocks for layout, themes, and the landing page.
architecture_content_detail: Every visible string has an English and Chinese source.
architecture_delivery_detail: Build with Vite, then deploy to Cloudflare Workers on workers.dev.
template_title: Change four things. Make it yours
template_description: This starter is made to be taken apart. Product identity and copy live in predictable places, and homepage sections do not depend on backend state.
template_step_1_detail: Update the central website configuration and replace the brand assets.
template_step_2_detail: Use the English and Chinese source messages to tell your own story.
template_step_3_detail: Reorder or remove homepage sections, then adjust the theme tokens.
template_step_4_detail: Connect your custom domain when your site is ready.
faq_1_q: Is TanStarter Lite a SaaS starter?
faq_1_a: No. TanStarter Lite is the lite version of TanStarter for simple websites. It has no accounts, payments, persistence, storage, cache, transactional email, newsletters, or admin surface.
faq_2_a: Yes. TanStack Router is already in place, so you can add an About, Docs, or Contact page when you need one. Those pages are not included by default.
faq_3_q: Does it require a Cloudflare database or storage bucket?
faq_3_a: No. The default Worker has no D1, R2, or KV bindings and needs no application secrets.
faq_4_q: Can I use my own domain?
faq_4_a: Yes. Start on workers.dev, then connect a custom domain whenever your site is ready.
closing_title: The simple site should be the simple project
closing_description: Start with a complete simple website. Keep the code easy to understand, and add only what the site proves it needs.
footer_tagline: A minimal bilingual website starter for Cloudflare Workers.
not_found_description: TanStarter Lite ships one simple landing page by default.
